answer_relevance.rationale: Directly answers whether the dataset is sufficient and states the key limitation.

biomedical_factual_correctness.rationale: Accurately identifies that age-of-onset and per-individual variant-burden data are required and absent.

completeness.rationale: Covers both missing age-of-onset data and missing per-individual variant-burden data.

uncertainty_abstention.rationale: Appropriately abstains from claiming a correlation can be tested and states insufficiency.
